description: Real data, nothing made up: one live reading of FLOP devnet as the workflow published it on observatory-data at commit 2152fe2. tape.jsonl, snapshot.json, run.json and SHA256SUMS are latest/ at that commit, byte for byte; log/2026-11-11.jsonl is the day file of the log at that commit. SHA256SUMS lists all nine published files; only these four are kept here.
